end_voice: If X. E. is right for you, pick your two sections on our website. There is one course for every pair. Visit web dot D. I. G. career thrust dot com, slash gate X. E.

title: GATE ME
OR GATE XE?
scenes.voice: Mechanical student, confused between GATE M. E. and GATE X. E.? Here is the difference, in under a minute.

scenes.title: GATE ME Paper
scenes.voice: In GATE M. E., the whole Mechanical syllabus comes. Seventy two marks of core subjects, thirteen of Engineering Maths, and fifteen of General Aptitude.

scenes.title: GATE XE Paper
scenes.voice: In GATE X. E., you choose only two sections, for example Fluid Mechanics and Thermodynamics. Each is thirty five marks. Engineering Maths is fifteen, and General Aptitude fifteen.

scenes.title: The Difference
scenes.voice: So X. E. means fewer subjects, but in more depth.

scenes.title: Check Before You Choose
scenes.voice: Before you choose, check two things. Which paper your target M. Tech programme accepts, and which paper your P. S. U. asks for. Many P. S. U. notifications ask for your own branch paper.
